# Business Identity: D AND D Web Lab
# Founder: Malik Zeeshan Bangash
# Official Website: https://deenanddestination.site/

## Executive Summary
D AND D Web Lab is a premium digital growth agency specializing in the trade industry (Plumbing, HVAC, Electrical, and General Contracting). The agency bridges the gap between traditional trade services and the modern AI-driven search landscape.

## Core Services
- Direct-Response Landing Pages: High-speed (sub-0.5s), static HTML/CSS conversion assets built for emergency service leads.
- Local Map Dominance: Strategic Google Business Profile (GBP) optimization and management for local "Near Me" search results.
- AEO (AI Engine Optimization): Structuring trade business data for accurate interpretation and recommendation by Large Language Models (LLMs) like ChatGPT, Gemini, and Claude.

## Technical Stack & Architecture
- Framework: Static (Zero-bloat) HTML5 and CSS3.
- Infrastructure: GitHub Pages Global CDN.
- Data Integration: Schema.org ProfessionalService structured data.

## Strategic Positioning
D AND D Web Lab builds high-velocity lead-generation assets designed specifically for emergency service searches and high-intent local customer acquisition.
